purpose: Offline original painted source assets for articulated cinematic pilot, never image generation at runtime.
bridge: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: background plate for an ORIGINAL 2D skeletal-animated game cinematic, Echoes of Dante, Organic Sci-Fi R3, painted raster game art, not photoreal photography. Create a WIDE 16:9 spaceship survey-bridge interior, with NO PEOPLE. Camera LOCKED, moderately elevated three-quarter perspective, looking from rear of bridge toward broad forward windows. Designed for animated human crew to be composited at x=430 and x=800, feet near 84% of frame height, about 35% of frame tall. A large continuous open floor walkway occupies the middle and lower half, never blocked by front desks. Rear left console sits at x=30% y=50%, waist-height when a standing person is in front of it, touch surface angled toward viewer; low rear-right navigation terminal at x=75% y=48%. Clear uninterrupted dark green-gray metal floor for characters to walk between them. Top central viewport shows the curved edge of an unfamiliar living planet with green land and pale clouds, quiet starfield, subdued violet orbital haze. Industrial human technology, well-used equipment, practical joints, ribs, switches, restrained amber #e0863f status lights and low sage displays #6bb464. Palette muted olive/slate matte metal, warm worn edges, amber practical lighting, slight violet #a98cff planetary rim. Illustrated painterly materials matching a high-quality 2D action RPG, broad readable volumes, soft contact shadows, appealing restrained detail, tangible depth. Light from upper left and window, enough warm face fill for crew, no harsh theatrical spotlight. Two structural vertical ribs frame the viewport asymmetrically, not a generic symmetrical temple. No fantasy, no glossy neon cyberpunk, no game UI, no readable lettering, no logos, no people, no chairs in the floor walkway, no front foreground console occluding legs. Single continuous setting without panels, camera blur, montage or text. Output 1536x864 or equivalent wide 16:9.
ivo: Use case: stylized-concept / game animation production. Edit the reference Ivo technician character into a CLEAN MODULAR CUTOUT ANIMATION PARTS ATLAS for Echoes of Dante, preserving his mature bald bearded face, goggles on top of head, olive work shirt with rolled sleeves, brown utility vest/harness, charcoal trousers, heavy boots, original painted semi-real 2D RPG material and warm upper-left illumination. This is a sprite production layout on REAL TRANSPARENT background, NOT a scene. EXACT 4 COLUMNS x 3 ROWS equally spaced grid, each part isolated within its cell with ample transparent margin, NO outlines, captions or grid lines, no parts touching. All body parts same rendering scale; we will resize them individually for rigging. Anatomically plausible proportions. Overall view mildly elevated 3/4 view, body facing slightly screen-left, relaxed crew NOT combat. Row 1 left to right: (1) TORSO ONLY from neck collar to waist, shoulders with short rolled sleeve caps, NO head, NO hanging arms or hands, NO legs. (2) PELVIS ONLY belt and hips/short upper trouser section, no legs. (3) HEAD with neck looking screen-left, mild three-quarter view, thoughtful calm expression, no body. (4) SAME man's HEAD with neck looking screen-right, matching likeness and light, no body. Row 2 left to right: (1) SINGLE UPPER ARM with rolled olive sleeve and bare elbow, oriented vertically shoulder top elbow bottom, round broad attachment end at top. (2) SINGLE FOREARM bare skin, vertical elbow top wrist bottom, no fingers. (3) SINGLE relaxed HUMAN HAND with short wrist, fingers loosely bent, wrist top fingers bottom. (4) SINGLE OPEN HUMAN HAND for conversational gesture, palm visible, wrist top fingers bottom, natural five fingers. Row 3 left to right: (1) SINGLE THIGH charcoal work trousers vertical hip top knee bottom. (2) SINGLE SHIN charcoal work trousers vertical knee top ankle bottom, no foot. (3) SINGLE BOOT isolated ankle at top sole at bottom, toe pointing screen-left in threequarter view. (4) SINGLE human HAND gently POINTING screen-left, index extended sideways, short wrist above. Parts are soft-edged painted volumes, modest fabric grain and skin highlights, not polygon shapes or vector. No tools or weapons. Keep every part fully inside its own equal cell. Real alpha transparency across entire background. Output one 4x3 atlas, approximately 1536x1152.
